SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  s.region,
  s.store_id,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.region, s.store_id
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, s.region, s.store_id
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  s.region,
  s.store_id,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.region, s.store_id
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, s.region, s.store_id
LIMIT 50

WITH q3_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.region,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.region, s.store_id
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM q3_sales WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT store_id FROM q3_sales WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
)
SELECT 
  q.fiscal_year,
  q.region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.store_id) AS store_count,
  ROUND(SUM(q.net_sales), 2) AS total_net_sales
FROM q3_sales q
JOIN lfl_stores l ON q.store_id = l.store_id
GROUP BY q.fiscal_year, q.region
ORDER BY q.region, q.fiscal_year DESC

WITH stores_by_year AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE WHEN d.calendar_date < '2025-04-01' THEN 'FY2024/25' ELSE 'FY2025/26' END AS fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
),
q3_sales_lfl AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.region
)
SELECT 
  q.fiscal_year,
  q.region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.store_id) AS store_count,
  ROUND(SUM(q.net_sales), 2) AS total_net_sales
FROM q3_sales_lfl q
GROUP BY q.fiscal_year, q.region
ORDER BY q.region, q.fiscal_year DESC

SELECT store_id FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND s.region = 'Capital Region'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
) AS fy26
UNION
SELECT store_id FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND s.region = 'Capital Region'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
) AS fy25
ORDER BY store_id

WITH fy25_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year,
    s.region,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY s.region, s.store_id
),
fy26_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year,
    s.region,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY s.region, s.store_id
),
lfl_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(fy25.region, fy26.region) AS region,
    fy25.store_id,
    COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) AS fy25_sales,
    COALESCE(fy26.net_sales, 0) AS fy26_sales
  FROM fy25_sales fy25
  FULL OUTER JOIN fy26_sales fy26 
    ON fy25.store_id = fy26.store_id 
    AND fy25.region = fy26.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  COUNT(*) AS store_count,
  ROUND(SUM(fy25_sales), 2) AS sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(SUM(fy26_sales), 2) AS sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((SUM(fy26_sales) - SUM(fy25_sales)) / SUM(fy25_sales)) * 100, 2) AS growth_percent
FROM lfl_comparison
WHERE fy25_sales > 0 AND fy26_sales > 0
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  MIN(d.calendar_date) AS quarter_start,
  MAX(d.calendar_date) AS quarter_end,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS total_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.store_key) AS active_stores,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC
